svg.title: Part (1) is the descent criterion in its exact form: the step maps are constant on the fibres of the presentation, so they are well defined on the common normed presentation R × bHP . With si = 2fi the constants are the scalar constant 4si and the activity constant 8γ used in the stability argument below. The exponent 301 is the actual finite interpolation order of the supplied construction; ana- lyticity of the descended maps is a consequence of the signed-moment bounds through Lemma 14.27 and is not an additional hypothesis. In the frame realization the activity space and its norm are transported isometrically by Theorem 9.4, and the step maps are intertwined by Theorem 14.20; the Lipschitz constants (LCN7) are therefore the same numbers for the lifted maps. The exactness class is exact recovery of the maps together with their norms.
